headline: Sean Payton says he's taking over playcalling for Broncos' offense
summary: Broncos coach Sean Payton said he is taking over the offensive playcalling beginning Sunday against the Chargers as the team looks to kick-start a sputtering offense.

headline: Cowboys say sick Joey Porter Jr. won't face Bucs on 'TNF'
summary: Joey Porter Jr. was ruled out of Thursday night's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers because of an illness.

headline: Bengals look to end 2-game skid against Dolphins with Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins status unclear
summary: — Joe Burrow has thrown a lot of passes to Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, but the Cincinnati quarterback may need to find another top option when the Bengals visit the Dolphins on Sunday with both of his top receivers dealing with injuries.

headline: Bears have opportunity to show again they've gained the upper hand in their rivalry with Packers
summary: — After beating the Green Bay Packers for the NFC North title and knocking them out of the playoffs last season, the Chicago Bears have one more opportunity to show definitively that a new chapter has started in the NFL’s most-played rivalry.
